Yemen Financial Inclusion Evidence

A bilingual public evidence resource for understanding financial inclusion in Yemen.

This page explains why the resource exists, what CauseWay contributes and does not claim, who remains authoritative for the data, and how to check, challenge and reuse what you find here. The resource does not make decisions for users or simulate policy outcomes.

Start with a questionVerify evidence
Understand → Explore → Verify

This resource presents the strongest defensible answer while keeping scope, limits and source visible.

01
Purpose

Why this exists

Yemen’s financial-inclusion evidence is fragmented across institutions, methods and time. That fragmentation creates a practical decision problem: a number can be individually correct and still be misleading when placed beside another number with a different denominator, definition or period. This resource exists to make the evidence usable without erasing those differences.

02
Purpose

What CauseWay adds

CauseWay’s contribution is not a new national statistic or a substitute for source institutions. It structures the resource so that questions link to evidence and sources, definitions, calculation bases and periods stay attached to numbers, disagreements remain inspectable, derived results can be reproduced, and material gaps become explicit measurement questions.

03
System context

The system the evidence is trying to describe

Financial inclusion sits inside a wider system: people and firms demand and use services; providers and channels supply them; payments and financial flows move value; infrastructure makes service possible; and regulation, consumer protection and programmes shape the conditions around access and use. Evidence about one part is informative, but it does not automatically establish the state of another.

04
Boundaries

What it does not do

This resource does not manufacture certainty that the evidence does not contain. It distinguishes people from accounts, access from use, infrastructure from outcomes, targets from observed results, and licensing from operating presence. When the evidence is insufficient, the gap remains visible and this resource states what evidence would be needed next and why it matters for the decision.

05
Stewardship

CauseWay’s role, who remains authoritative, and how to check or challenge

CauseWay’s role: CauseWay develops and maintains this resource. It is responsible for how the evidence is organised and linked, for its own synthesis, documented derivations and editorial analysis, and for correcting errors.

Who remains authoritative: Original publishers remain authoritative for the data and publications they issue. Organising the evidence does not make CauseWay a regulator, statistical authority or source owner. This resource does not confirm whether any named institution is currently licensed or operating. Nothing on this resource is financial, legal or regulatory advice, or confirmation of any institution’s current status. Attribution to CauseWay covers only its own synthesis, derivations and analysis and does not imply that any original publisher endorses them. Citation, factual use and redistribution are separate permissions.

How to check or challenge: Each figure is recorded in an evidence record that names its original source wherever that source can be named publicly. Material findings are checked against the source they are attributed to, including its unit, population or calculation base, geography, period and method; a figure known only from a secondary source is labelled as secondary. To report a suspected error, write to office@causewaygrp.com with the record or source reference. When a material public conclusion changes, the evidence record and a correction note are updated together.

06
Stewardship

Who it is for — and how to use it responsibly

The same evidence base is designed to serve, at different levels of depth, public institutions, the financial sector, development partners, researchers, journalists and the public. The Arabic and English editions are equally authoritative and carry the same numbers, scope, limitations, certainty and rights conditions. When reusing material, keep the figure’s meaning, period, applicable population and source limitations; check the original publisher’s terms; and cite the original source, and CauseWay’s processing where it materially shapes the result.
